value.rationale: The exactly specified measured observable is the integrated optical scattering power of a noisy emitter. For large detuning there are two separated, nonempty regimes in jump amplitude supporting a finite optimal rate, separated by a full suppression band; this is a global physical control classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The unique noise-rate-blind total-power point nevertheless converts incoherent into coherent scattering at explicitly quantified rates, distinguishing total-intensity diagnosis from phase-resolved observations. The classification addresses experimental interpretation of motional narrowing; no general-drive or experimental magnitude claims are inferred.
